name: Adobe Inc.
summary: A high-ROIC software franchise at ~10x non-GAAP earnings, but generative-AI disruption, a CEO handover (1 Dec) and an interim CFO leave the story unproven; the corrected Sticker is only ~$230.

name: Kinsale Capital Group, Inc.
summary: An exceptional specialty insurer (combined ratio ~76%, ROIC 23%), but on normalised earnings it is above all three corrected prices because E&S property pricing is softening; wait for a lower price or Q3 proof.

name: lululemon athletica inc.
summary: A high-ROIC brand with net cash and a new CEO, but US sales are shrinking, earnings are falling and TTM EPS is flattered; wait for a lower price or proof the product fix works.
